{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are too low during price rallies, showing significant lag that's especially pronounced when sentiment turns positive from low levels",
    "When prices are near their historical mean, model outputs underperform because they haven't fully incorporated the recent upward momentum",
    "Sentiment turning positive from bearish levels (below 0.5) requires lifting forecasts by approximately 1-2 euros to capture the delayed price response",
    "The forecast bias increases as the lookback period extends, with 30-day forecasts showing 0.5-1.0 euro divergence from true outcomes",
    "When prices have been consolidating around 62-64 EUR, model forecasts are consistently below the observed stabilization range",
    "Sentiment indicators have minimal impact when prices are in a clear uptrend, regardless of the sentiment value",
    "Model mean-reversion to historical averages causes premature price predictions that get invalidated by persistent momentum"
] }
